digest.component_or_area: complexity linting gate and baseline ratchet
propositions: C901 complexity diagnostics over production code in src/rebar exceed threshold 15 and require a shrink-only baseline to prevent new or increased debt while allowing improvements
A wrapper script must accept live Ruff findings, compare against committed ceilings, and exit zero only when all current scores are at or below recorded limits
The baseline persists function-level ceilings keyed by repository-relative POSIX path plus AST-qualified symbol, rejecting duplicates and schema violations
Maintenance mode --update-stale can only lower or remove stale ceilings and must refuse new or increased debt via guarded atomic write
Integration into make lint routes production C901 over src/rebar through the wrapper while preserving existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests
